==About me==

I am an American-born writer aspiring to move to beautiful Vancouver, BC in Canada. I am fascinated by languages, social theory, gender philosophy, shiny objects, politics, different cultures, honesty, and trust. I love all things Canadian and plot to become Canadian. Hockey and curling are the only sports I will willingly watch. As a ''rabid'' hockey fan I support the Vancouver Canucks, Pittsburgh Penguins, Manitoba Moose, and Vancouver Giants in hockey. In curling it's Team Canada and Jennifer Jones all the way!

Writing is my passion. Words are my paint. I can only dream of being as talented as RJ. He was a true master storyweaver. The WoT is something I can re-read and never grow tired. Currently on my 19th re-read of the series. Now I will become entirely addicted to this site and editing pages. '''THANKS GUYS!''' >.>

I am a woman who is outspoken, beautiful, passionate, honest, intelligent, curious, elusive, difficult, and entirely shameless about all of it.

''~Walk in Beauty~'' '''Fox''' 22:02, March 23, 2010 (UTC)
